Anivia.escape: Right after dodging the stun from Anivia Q Flash Frost is your chance to close the distance. Avoid narrow paths where Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape, and chain Syndra E Scatter the Weak's stun in an open area. If Anivia P Rebirth has already been used, look for a kill while she has no way to revive.
Anivia.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Anivia's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If Anivia P Rebirth's healing lets her survive your combo, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Anivia.combo: To look for a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond Anivia and push the sphere into her with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. For a short trade, slow her with Syndra W Force of Will, then hit her with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. To go for a kill, prepare spheres ahead of time and finish with Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, Syndra E Scatter the Weak using the remaining spheres, then Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Anivia.fight: After dodging Anivia Q Flash Frost, slow her with Syndra W Force of Will, then follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. Anivia has no mobility, so there are chances to catch her, but Syndra also has no skill to escape on her own, so managing distance comes first. If the risk of being caught by Anivia's stun and wall remains, don't use Syndra E Scatter the Weak to harass; save it to create distance again.
Anivia.laning: Set up Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Anivia steps up to last-hit to look for harass without taking damage in return.
Anivia.phase: Syndra gets stronger in the mid and late game as she gains Splinters and ability power, but position carefully around Anivia's terrain control and Syndra's low durability.
Anivia.teamfight: Stay furthest back and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Set up spheres before a fight to prepare a stun angle with Syndra E Scatter the Weak and damage from Syndra R Unleashed Power, and judge when to use Syndra E Scatter the Weak to push back approaching enemies. Avoid narrow paths where Anivia W Crystallize could separate you from your allies, and use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can certainly kill.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost can be detonated in place with a recast to stun, so don't just sidestep its path; stay out of range from the start. If you are hit by Anivia Q Flash Frost or are inside a fully grown Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals increased damage, so get out of the storm immediately. Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape in narrow paths, so don't start a fight there.

Naafiri.phase: In the mid game, Naafiri's roams are the biggest danger, so maintain broad vision and don't get caught alone. In the late game, Syndra gets strong as her fragments and ability power stack, so hold a safe position and group with allies to limit Naafiri's engage angles.
Naafiri.build: Hold on early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Naafiri's main damage is physical, so build armor first. If the combo can be survived through healing, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon. Also get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier so you can withstand her dash.
Naafiri.combo: If Naafiri gets close, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere at your feet or where Naafiri will land, then push her back with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun her and create distance. When attacking, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere behind Naafiri to set up a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Before finishing, place spheres in advance and use Syndra R Unleashed Power after Naafiri W The Call of the Pack ends.
Naafiri.escape: Don't go in just because Naafiri E Eviscerate is down. Look for an opening before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back, and stun her with Syndra E Scatter the Weak then to limit her chance to escape. If Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, wait until she can be targeted before using Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Naafiri.fight: Get a free poke with Syndra Q Dark Sphere when Naafiri steps up to last-hit. Slow her first with Syndra W Force of Will, then follow with Syndra Q Dark Sphere, and save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for when Naafiri gets close. Right after Naafiri E Eviscerate revives her pack, clear it with an area ability such as Syndra E Scatter the Weak and counterattack.
Naafiri.teamfight: Stay at the back, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere in advance, and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra W Force of Will. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to push back Naafiri's engage, and use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill after preparing spheres. Don't travel alone while Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is available, and retreat immediately after an ally dies so you don't get caught in succession.
Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once, create distance until the bleed ends to avoid a second hit. Naafiri E Eviscerate dashes, heals, and revives her pack, so don't give her an angle to approach and save Syndra E Scatter the Weak. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she can't be targeted for a short time, so use Syndra R Unleashed Power after it ends.

Yone.build: If the enemy composition has an assassin, rush Zhonya's Hourglass to survive the moment after they engage. Yone's damage includes both physical and magic damage, so don't rely on building resistance to only one type. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that only stack health heavily.
Yone.combo: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Yone will engage, then push him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to aim for both a stun and distance. To poke first, slow him with Syndra W Force of Will, then follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. Before finishing, place as many spheres as possible, then use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Yone.escape: Don't engage just because Yone E Soul Unbound is down; also check Yone Q Mortal Steel's tornado and Yone R Fate Sealed. In particular, the opening to catch him is before Yone R Fate Sealed is available again, while Syndra E Scatter the Weak is ready.
Yone.fight: Keep your distance when Yone's tornado from Yone Q Mortal Steel is ready, and push him away with Syndra E Scatter the Weak if he engages with Yone E Soul Unbound. The opening to engage is before Yone R Fate Sealed is available again. Catch him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak then, build up spheres, and finish with Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Yone.laning: Farm safely from long range, and poke with Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Yone steps up to last-hit. Don't fully push the wave, and save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for his engage.
Yone.phase: Syndra grows stronger in the mid and late game as her shards and ability power stack, but keep your distance so poor positioning doesn't let Yone engage on you.
Yone.teamfight: Poke from the backline with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will, and use Syndra E Scatter the Weak to push away Yone when he engages. Yone W Spirit Cleave's shield grows when it hits more champions, so don't stand grouped with your allies. Yone R Fate Sealed sends Yone behind the last champion in its path, so check your position in the backline. Use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, his tornado will be ready, so keep your distance until the stacks expire. Yone can dive in with Yone E Soul Unbound or reach the backline with Yone R Fate Sealed, so it's important not to use Syndra E Scatter the Weak early to poke.

Akshan.fight: Don't use Syndra E Scatter the Weak to harass while Akshan E Heroic Swing is available. If Akshan engages, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere at his landing point and push him back with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to create distance. Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing is used, he has fewer ways to escape, so look for a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Akshan.teamfight: Syndra should harass from the back with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will, while saving Syndra E Scatter the Weak for an engaging Akshan. Set up spheres before a fight to prepare a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak and damage from Syndra R Unleashed Power, and use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can certainly kill. If Akshan W Going Rogue marks you as a Scoundrel, don't face Akshan alone and fight outside his execute range.
Akshan.build: Akshan's main damage is physical and Syndra has low armor, so buy Cloth Armor early and build armor. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Akshan.combo: Throw a minion or sphere with Syndra W Force of Will to slow Akshan, then hit him with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. To look for a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond Akshan and push it into him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. To finish him, set up as many spheres as possible, then use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Akshan.escape: Right after forcing Akshan to use Akshan E Heroic Swing is Syndra's chance to close the distance. At that moment, push Syndra Q Dark Sphere from beyond Akshan with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun him, then attack.
Akshan.laning: Harass Akshan with Syndra Q Dark Sphere where he steps up to last-hit, and don't stay behind the minion wave for long because of Akshan Q Avengerang. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for Akshan E Heroic Swing, and don't fully push the wave.
Akshan.phase: Early on, Syndra has to manage high mana and cooldown costs, so focus on farming safely. In the mid and late game, make use of Syndra P Transcendent's upgrades and your ability power, but position so Akshan cannot engage, since your armor is low.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits a minion, so don't stand behind the wave and dodge its full path in both directions. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to use when Akshan engages with Akshan E Heroic Swing. If you are targeted by Akshan R Comeuppance while low on health, get behind terrain to block the shots.

Karma.combo: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere behind Karma and push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun her. To poke without a stun, slow her first with Syndra W Force of Will, then follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. To finish her, place as many spheres on the field as possible, then use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Karma.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Karma’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra lets her withstand your combo, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Karma.escape: Close the distance when Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the root threat is gone. After the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra ends, stun her with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to create a chance to kill her.
Karma.fight: Syndra has no escape ability, so keep your distance first. Slow Karma with Syndra W Force of Will, then hit her with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. Once Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra has ended, look for a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Karma.laning: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Karma will step to last-hit and poke her, but save Syndra E Scatter the Weak in case Karma closes the distance. Don’t fully push the wave and create a gank angle for the enemy jungler.
Karma.phase: Syndra gets stronger in the mid-to-late game with Syndra P Transcendent, but mispositioning is dangerous, so fight from the backline.
Karma.teamfight: From the very back of the formation, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere in advance and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra W Force of Will. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to knock away enemies who approach. After the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra ends, use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill.
Karma.watch: If Karma Q Inner Flame hits you, Karma P Gathering Fire reduces the cooldown on Karma R Mantra, so dodge from behind minions or outside its range. Immediately leave the circle left by Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break it before you’re rooted.

Ahri.laning: Harass Ahri with Syndra Q Dark Sphere where she steps up to last-hit, and keep the minion line between you so you can dodge Ahri E Charm. Hold Syndra E Scatter the Weak to answer Ahri's engage, and don't fully push the wave.
Ahri.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ahri's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, but remember that the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return cannot be reduced by resistance. If Ahri P Essence Theft's healing lets her survive your combo, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Ahri.combo: After dodging Ahri E Charm, throw a sphere or minion with Syndra W Force of Will to slow her, then follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. To look for a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere behind Ahri and push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. To finish her, set up as many spheres as possible, then use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Ahri.escape: If Ahri E Charm has just missed, look for a stun with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is available, place a sphere where she will dash and be ready to push her back with Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Ahri.fight: Start trading right after you dodge Ahri E Charm from behind the minions. Slow her with Syndra W Force of Will, then follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is down, look for a chance to catch her with Syndra E Scatter the Weak's stun.
Ahri.phase: Syndra gets stronger in the mid and late game as she gains Splinters and ability power, but a bad position is dangerous, so keep your distance.
Ahri.teamfight: Stay furthest back and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to catch enemies diving in with Ahri R Spirit Rush, and set up spheres before a fight to prepare a stun angle. Look for an opening when Ahri E Charm is down and Ahri is vulnerable, but use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can certainly kill.
Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm catches you, you may take her entire follow-up combo, so move with the minion line between you and her. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit you on its return, and the return damage is true damage, so keep moving out of its return path even after dodging the first pass. Watch for a dash while Ahri R Spirit Rush is available.

Akali.watch: Dodge the first shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip first. If it marks you, the second dash will follow fleeing Syndra, so if you are hit, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere at the landing point and be ready with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. You cannot dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, and its second hit deals more damage based on your missing health, so create distance with Syndra E Scatter the Weak right after she engages.
Akali.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Akali’s main magic damage, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If Syndra lets Akali engage, escaping with just one use of Syndra E Scatter the Weak is difficult, so buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier. Akali tends to have high magic resistance, so include penetration in your offensive items and make use of the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will.
Akali.combo: To harass, throw a sphere or minion with Syndra W Force of Will to slow Akali, then hit her with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. To look for a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond Akali and push it into her with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. To finish her, set up enough spheres first, then use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Akali.escape: After dodging the first shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip and before Akali R Perfect Execution is back up, look for a chance to engage. Don't go in just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down; she can escape with another mobility tool, so check what she still has available. In that opening, stun her with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak, then attack.
Akali.fight: After dodging the first shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip, trade from a safe distance. If Akali comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to attack, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where she will land and push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to look for a stun. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to answer Akali's engage.
Akali.laning: Set up Syndra Q Dark Sphere in advance where Akali steps up to last-hit to look for poke without taking damage in return. Don’t fully push the wave and create an opening for the enemy jungler to gank; save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for Akali’s engage.
Akali.phase: Syndra grows stronger in the mid and late game as she gains Splinters and ability power, but a bad position is dangerous, so fight from the back.
Akali.teamfight: Syndra should stay furthest back and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Set up spheres before the formations come together to prepare a stun angle with Syndra E Scatter the Weak and damage from Syndra R Unleashed Power. If Akali engages, push her back with Syndra E Scatter the Weak, and use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can certainly kill.

Annie.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Annie's damage is mainly magic and Syndra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Annie.combo: To look for a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere behind Annie, then push the sphere with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. For a slow and harass, hit Annie with Syndra W Force of Will, then follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. To finish her, set up enough spheres to increase the damage from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Annie.escape: Right after Annie P Pyromania's stun is used is your chance to close the distance and pressure her. Annie has no mobility, so if you get close during this window, you can catch her with Syndra E Scatter the Weak's stun. If you see her stun is ready again, back out of Annie's ability range.
Annie.fight: When Annie P Pyromania's stun is down, pressure her from long range with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. If Annie steps forward, slow her with Syndra W Force of Will, then follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to push Annie back if she closes the distance.
Annie.phase: Early on, Syndra has high mana and ability costs, so prioritize farming safely. Syndra is strong in the mid and late game as she gains Splinters and ability power, but a bad position is dangerous, so keep your distance.
Annie.teamfight: Don't stand on top of allies when Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready or Annie is out of sight. Syndra should harass from the back with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will, saving Syndra E Scatter the Weak to push back an advancing Annie. Use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can certainly kill.
Annie.watch: When the white glow signals a stun from Annie P Pyromania, stay out of Annie's ability range. Don't stand on top of allies so you aren't all hit by Annie R Summon: Tibbers' area damage and stun. After Tibbers is summoned, don't stay where you are, even if you kill Annie.

AurelionSol.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurelion Sol's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't rely on building only health.
AurelionSol.combo: If Aurelion Sol closes in with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere at your feet or where he will land, then push him back with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to create distance. To attack, slow him first with Syndra W Force of Will, then follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. Set up as many Syndra Q Dark Sphere as possible before finishing with Syndra R Unleashed Power.
AurelionSol.escape: Right after forcing Aurelion Sol to use Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is Syndra's window to close the distance. At that moment, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond him and push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to look for a stun. After using Syndra E Scatter the Weak, Syndra has no skill to escape on her own, so watch for Aurelion Sol's tools to catch you.
AurelionSol.fight: While Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is available, don't use Syndra E Scatter the Weak to harass; be ready to counter his engage. If Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, slow him with Syndra W Force of Will, then follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere to pressure him. Aurelion Sol has relatively low magic resistance, making him a good target for Syndra's magic damage.
AurelionSol.phase: Early on, Syndra should pressure Aurelion Sol while he has few growth stacks. Syndra gets stronger in the mid and late game too, but the more permanent growth stacks Aurelion Sol gains, the harder he is to deal with, so position carefully.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Syndra should stay furthest back and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Set up spheres before the enemy formation closes in to prepare a stun angle with Syndra E Scatter the Weak, and push Aurelion Sol back if he comes in with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight. Keep some distance from allies to avoid being hit together by the empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, and use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can certainly kill.
AurelionSol.watch: If you are caught in Aurelion Sol E Singularity, walk out immediately, and avoid even its edge when low on health. After Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered, spread out from your allies.

Aurora.build: Aurora's main damage is magic, and Syndra has relatively low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If Aurora P Spirit Abjuration's healing lets her survive your combo, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Aurora.combo: To harass, throw a sphere or minion with Syndra W Force of Will to slow Aurora, then hit her with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. If Aurora gets on top of you, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere at your feet or where she will land, then push her back with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to create distance. To kill her, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere and throw it with Syndra W Force of Will, then push the remaining spheres with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun her and finish with Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Aurora.escape: Don't engage just because Aurora W Across the Veil is down. Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora R Between Worlds are also mobility tools, so especially look for an opening before Aurora R Between Worlds is back up. At that point, catch Aurora with Syndra E Scatter the Weak and fight using the spheres you have set up.
Aurora.fight: Look for harass without taking damage in return with Syndra Q Dark Sphere when Aurora steps up to last-hit. Slow her with Syndra W Force of Will, then follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere; save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to defend yourself when Aurora can dash in. If Aurora disappears with Aurora W Across the Veil, don't rush Syndra R Unleashed Power; wait for her to reappear.
Aurora.phase: Syndra gets stronger in the mid and late game as she gains Splinters and ability power, but a bad position is dangerous, so keep your distance.
Aurora.teamfight: Syndra should stay furthest back and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Set up spheres before a fight to prepare a stun angle with Syndra E Scatter the Weak, and save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to push back Aurora's engage. If Aurora engages and fails to kill anyone, look for a chance to catch her, and use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can certainly kill.
Aurora.watch: If you are hit by Aurora Q Twofold Hex, get out of the line connecting you and Aurora before the curse is pulled back. The return damage is higher the lower your health, so back off if your health is in a risky spot. If Aurora disappears with Aurora W Across the Veil, wait for her to reappear or place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where she will land; move outside the area before Aurora R Between Worlds forms.

Azir.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Azir’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads and prioritize magic resistance.
Azir.combo: To set up a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond Azir and push it into him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. To finish him, place spheres in advance, throw one with Syndra W Force of Will to slow him, then push the remaining spheres with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun him before using Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Azir.escape: Right after forcing Azir to use Azir E Shifting Sands is your chance to close the gap. If you look for a stun with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak during this window, Azir will have trouble escaping. If Azir R Emperor’s Divide is still available, watch your approach position because he can knock you back.
Azir.fight: Deal a quick burst when Azir’s soldiers are stationary or Azir E Shifting Sands is down. Slow him with Syndra W Force of Will, then land Syndra Q Dark Sphere. If Azir E Shifting Sands is still available, save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to answer his engage.
Azir.laning: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Azir steps up to last-hit, but don’t fully shove the wave and expose yourself to a gank.
Azir.phase: Azir also gets stronger as the game goes on, so take short trades when his soldiers and Azir E Shifting Sands are unavailable.
Azir.teamfight: Stay behind your team, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere in advance, and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra W Force of Will. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to knock back an engaging enemy or stun them with a sphere. Use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can reliably kill. Don’t group up and engage through a narrow passage where Azir R Emperor’s Divide can knock several of you back.
Azir.watch: Don’t stand for long in a soldier’s straight line after Azir W Arise! summons it. Keep your distance even after Azir Q Conquering Sands moves the soldier. Azir R Emperor’s Divide can knock back several enemies in a narrow passage, so don’t engage together there.

Corki.build: Buy Cloth Armor early to help you survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps. Prioritize armor against Corki’s main damage, but first make sure to get out of Corki E Gatling Gun’s area. Corki P Hextech Munitions’ true damage can’t be mitigated with resistances.
Corki.combo: To set up a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond Corki and push it into him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. If Corki closes in with Corki W Valkyrie, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere at his landing point, then push him back with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to create distance. When finishing him, place as many spheres as possible before using Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Corki.escape: The moment after Corki uses Corki W Valkyrie is your opening to go in. If you stun him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak then, Corki will have trouble creating distance again.
Corki.fight: Don’t force an approach while Corki W Valkyrie is available. Look for an angle to stun him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak right after Corki W Valkyrie is used. For a short trade, slow him with Syndra W Force of Will, then land Syndra Q Dark Sphere.
Corki.laning: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Corki steps up to last-hit to pressure his early scaling. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak in case Corki uses Corki W Valkyrie to engage, and don’t fully shove the wave and create an opening for a gank.
Corki.phase: Syndra also gets stronger in the mid-to-late game with splinters and ability power, but Corki also grows stronger as he builds items, so hold your position and make it hard for him to fire missiles freely.
Corki.teamfight: Stay as far back as possible and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Place spheres before the fight to set up a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak and damage with Syndra R Unleashed Power. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to knock back an engaging enemy, and use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can reliably kill.
Corki.watch: Corki E Gatling Gun reduces your armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of trying to withstand it head-on. Corki R Missile Barrage also hits around its first target, so don’t hide behind minions; get out of range. In particular, reposition to avoid getting hit by the third missile in succession.

Ekko.build: Build magic resistance first against Ekko’s main damage, and buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to help you survive. Choose Mercury’s Treads to account for the stun from Ekko W Parallel Convergence. If Ekko R Chronobreak’s healing lets him survive your combo, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Ekko.combo: To poke, throw a minion or sphere with Syndra W Force of Will to slow Ekko, then land Syndra Q Dark Sphere. If he engages with Ekko E Phase Dive, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where he’ll land, then use Syndra E Scatter the Weak to push him back and aim to stun him and create distance. If Ekko R Chronobreak is down and you have a chance to kill him, place plenty of spheres before finishing with Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Ekko.escape: Don’t go deep just because Ekko E Phase Dive is down. Start a fight during the window before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back, especially when Ekko W Parallel Convergence is also down. Stun him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak then to make it hard for him to escape.
Ekko.fight: While Ekko E Phase Dive is available, save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for his engage instead of using it to poke. When Ekko closes in, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where he’ll land, then push him back with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to create distance. Start a full fight after Ekko R Chronobreak is down.
Ekko.laning: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Ekko steps up to last-hit and look for a poke without losing out. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for Ekko E Phase Dive, and don’t fully shove the wave and give him a gank angle.
Ekko.phase: Syndra grows stronger in the mid-to-late game with Syndra P Transcendent, but keep your distance because mispositioning is dangerous.
Ekko.teamfight: Stay as far back as possible, poke with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will, and place spheres before a fight. Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, look for a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to force Ekko R Chronobreak or stop his engage. Use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can reliably kill.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the area to avoid its stun and shield. Also move out of the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. Be ready to use Syndra E Scatter the Weak when Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive. If you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, don’t chase recklessly even if health is low.

Fizz.build: Fizz deals mostly magic damage, and Syndra has relatively low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury’s Treads. Get Zhonya’s Hourglass early so you can survive right after he engages.
Fizz.combo: When Fizz engages, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where he’ll land, then use Syndra E Scatter the Weak to push him back and aim to stun him and create distance. If you attack after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere behind him and push it into him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun him. When finishing him, place as many spheres as possible before using Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Fizz.escape: Your chance to engage is after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down and before it comes back. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, he can use it to escape, so don’t chase recklessly just because one mobility spell is down. While Fizz E Playful / Trickster is unavailable, hit him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to prevent his escape.
Fizz.fight: Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak while Fizz E Playful / Trickster is available. When Fizz engages, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where he’ll land, then push him back with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to create distance. Counterattack with your remaining crowd control and damage spells right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down.
Fizz.phase: Syndra gets stronger in the mid-to-late game as she gains splinters and ability power, but keep watching for Fizz’s engage so you don’t misposition.
Fizz.teamfight: Stay with your team at the very back of the formation and disrupt the enemy with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to knock Fizz back when he engages, and focus him with your team once Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down.
Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster can be used both to engage and escape, so don’t use Syndra E Scatter the Weak to poke before it’s down. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere along the path Fizz would take to follow up with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, then knock him back with Syndra E Scatter the Weak.

Galio.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Galio’s main magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads and prioritize magic resistance.
Galio.combo: To set up a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond Galio and push it into him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. If Galio closes in, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere under yourself or at his landing point, then push him back with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to create distance. When finishing him, place as many spheres as possible before using Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Galio.escape: Don’t engage just because Galio E Justice Punch is down. Look for a window before Galio R Hero’s Entrance comes back, and after avoiding the taunt range of Galio W Shield of Durand, look for a stun with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Galio.fight: Maintain distance with your longer range, and don’t unload your damage while Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand. Slow him with Syndra W Force of Will, then land Syndra Q Dark Sphere to trade. When Galio can engage, save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for his approach instead of using it to poke.
Galio.laning: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Galio steps up to last-hit and poke him, but don’t mindlessly shove the wave all the way and give him a gank angle. If Galio spends mana using his abilities to clear the wave, push the lane to limit his chance to affect other lanes with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Galio.phase: The mid-to-late game, when Syndra has accumulated splinters and ability power, is a strong period for her, but hold your position so Galio can’t catch you with his engage.
Galio.teamfight: Stay as far back as possible and poke with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Use Syndra E Scatter the Weak to knock back Galio when he engages. Place spheres before a fight to set up a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak and damage with Syndra R Unleashed Power. When you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero’s Entrance, leave the area. Use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can reliably kill.
Galio.watch: Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see him step back to prepare it, and watch for the follow-up crowd control if it hits. When Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand, it reduces incoming damage, so walk out of taunt range. Avoid the point where both gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap. When you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero’s Entrance, leave the area immediately.

Hwei.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle to help you survive the early game, and choose Mercury’s Treads. Hwei deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first.
Hwei.combo: When Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere behind him and push it into him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun him. If you can slow him first, use Syndra W Force of Will followed by Syndra Q Dark Sphere. When finishing him, place as many spheres as possible before using Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility spell, so close the gap after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. Look for a stun in that window with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, wait to engage because he can root or displace you.
Hwei.fight: The moment after Hwei uses Hwei E Subject: Torment to poke or clear the wave is your chance to close the gap. Slow him first with Syndra W Force of Will, then land Syndra Q Dark Sphere to trade. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, don’t use Syndra E Scatter the Weak for a reckless poke.
Hwei.laning: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Hwei steps up to last-hit and look for a poke without losing out. Don’t fully shove the wave and give him a gank angle. Watch for the eyes and zones Hwei has placed, and don’t enter them.
Hwei.phase: Early on, Syndra has high mana costs and spell-use demands, so prioritize farming. Look for lane control as Syndra Q Dark Sphere gains levels. She gets stronger in the mid-to-late game as she gains splinters and ability power, but she is fragile, so hold a safe position.
Hwei.teamfight: Stay as far back as possible, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere in advance, and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra W Force of Will. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to knock back an engaging enemy or stun them in combination with a sphere. Target Hwei when Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, and use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can reliably kill.
Hwei.watch: If you’re caught by Hwei E Subject: Torment’s root or pull, you can take follow-up damage, so don’t approach recklessly while this ability is available. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster’s slow and max-health-based damage are dangerous, so leave the marked area. If the first spell hits you, reposition immediately to avoid the second spell and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.

Irelia.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Syndra has low armor, so build armor first. If Irelia’s healing from Q Bladesurge lets her withstand your combo, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Irelia.combo: To stop Irelia’s approach, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where she will land, then push the sphere with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to try to stun and knock her back. To poke, slow her first with Syndra W Force of Will, then hit her with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. To finish her, place spheres in advance and use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Irelia.escape: Right after forcing Irelia to use Q Bladesurge is your chance to close the distance and attack. Look for a stun then with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, there’s one less crowd-control ability to watch out for when you engage.
Irelia.fight: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Irelia will step to last-hit, and poke safely. If she tries to close in with Irelia Q Bladesurge, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where she will land, then push her away with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to create distance. Right after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge, look for a chance to stun her with Syndra E Scatter the Weak and trade.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between Syndra and Irelia. Take a step back as minions are about to die. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for Irelia’s engage, and don’t fully push the wave and give the enemy jungler a gank angle.
Irelia.phase: Syndra gets stronger in the mid-to-late game as she gains Splinters and ability power, but she has low health and armor, so position carefully.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia, as she can split the formation with R Vanguard's Edge and stun multiple people with E Flawless Duet. Syndra should use Q Dark Sphere and W Force of Will from the very back of the formation, and save E Scatter the Weak to knock Irelia away when she engages.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close the distance, so back away as minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you get trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear. Leaving through the barrier deals extra damage and applies a strong slow.

Kassadin.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Kassadin deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance. If his engage threat grows, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier.
Kassadin.combo: To poke, slow him first by throwing a minion or sphere with Syndra W Force of Will, then hit him with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. To set up a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond him and push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. To finish him, place plenty of spheres first, then use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Kassadin.escape: When Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, you have a chance to engage. Look for a stun with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak then, making it difficult for Kassadin to escape.
Kassadin.laning: Early on, consider your mana and the time between skill uses, and only poke when needed. Don’t spam abilities near Kassadin and reduce the cooldown on Kassadin E Force Pulse for him.
Kassadin.phase: Don’t stand alone in the late game, as Kassadin can dive the backline.
Kassadin.teamfight: Stay back and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Place spheres before a fight, and knock Kassadin away with Syndra E Scatter the Weak if he comes in with R Riftwalk. Use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield absorbs Syndra’s magic poke, so deal damage after his Q is down.

Leblanc.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand LeBlanc’s magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, and prioritize magic resistance over armor afterward too. Get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier in case she engages on you.
Leblanc.combo: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where LeBlanc will come in, then push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to try to stun her and create distance. To counterattack, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond LeBlanc, then push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun her. To finish her, place as many Syndra Q Dark Spheres as possible before using Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Leblanc.escape: Right after LeBlanc uses W Distortion is your chance to close the distance. However, don’t chase recklessly while she can return to her original position. Once the return window has passed or she has already used the return, catch her with Syndra E Scatter the Weak and counterattack. If you’re caught by LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains, first leave the chain’s range to avoid the root.
Leblanc.fight: While LeBlanc W Distortion is available, don’t use Syndra E Scatter the Weak to poke; save it for her engage. From a safe distance, slow her with Syndra W Force of Will, then hit her with Syndra Q Dark Sphere to trade. If she comes in with LeBlanc W Distortion, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where she will land, then push her away with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to create distance.
Leblanc.laning: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where LeBlanc will step to last-hit and poke her. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for her engage. Don’t fully push the wave, and alert your team as soon as LeBlanc disappears from vision.
Leblanc.phase: Syndra gets stronger in the mid-to-late game as she gains Splinters and ability power, but if you misposition, you may take successive hits after LeBlanc engages, so fight from the backline.
Leblanc.teamfight: Stay at the back and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for when LeBlanc comes in, and place spheres before a fight to prepare a stun. Use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill after building up enough spheres.
Leblanc.watch: If you’re marked by LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice, her next ability deals more damage, so don’t move forward; back away until the mark disappears. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, leave the chain’s range before it roots you. When she comes in with LeBlanc W Distortion, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where she will land and be ready to knock her away with Syndra E Scatter the Weak.

Lissandra.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. If the healing from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb lets her withstand your combo, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Lissandra.combo: If Lissandra closes in with Lissandra E Glacial Path, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where she will land, then push her with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun her and create distance. To kill her, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere, throw it with Syndra W Force of Will, then push the remaining spheres with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun her and finish with Syndra R Unleashed Power. If Lissandra can cast R Frozen Tomb on herself, don’t burst all your damage at once; time it for when her stasis ends.
Lissandra.escape: Right after Lissandra E Glacial Path is down is your chance to close the distance. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down, trade and use Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun her so she can’t escape.
Lissandra.fight: Trade right after Lissandra uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. Slow her with Syndra W Force of Will, then hit her with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. While Lissandra E Glacial Path is available, save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for her engage.
Lissandra.laning: Stand at an angle from allied minions to avoid Lissandra Q Ice Shard’s piercing path. Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Lissandra will step to last-hit and poke her. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for her engage, and don’t fully push the wave.
Lissandra.phase: The mid-to-late game, as Syndra gains Splinters and ability power, is her peak, but mispositioning is dangerous, so fight while keeping your distance.
Lissandra.teamfight: From the backline, disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Place spheres in advance to set up a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak and increase the damage of Syndra R Unleashed Power. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for an engage through Lissandra E Glacial Path, and use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting its first target, so don’t stand in a line with allied minions. She can engage with Lissandra E Glacial Path, then root you with Lissandra W Ring of Frost and stun you with Lissandra R Frozen Tomb. Keep your distance to avoid taking damage in quick succession.

Lux.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lux deals mostly magic damage, and Syndra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lux.combo: If Lux Q Light Binding misses, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere behind Lux and push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun her. Syndra E Scatter the Weak alone won’t stun, so make sure the sphere is beyond Lux. To finish her, place as many Syndra Q Dark Spheres as possible before using Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Lux.escape: Go in during the window after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Lux has no mobility ability, so if you’ve closed the distance, you can catch her with Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Lux.fight: Lure Lux Q Light Binding and dodge it to create a chance to trade. Lux has no mobility ability, so close the distance and catch her with the stun from Syndra E Scatter the Weak. You can also slow her first with Syndra W Force of Will, then follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere.
Lux.laning: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Lux will step to last-hit and look for a safe poke. Don’t fully push the wave, and spread out sideways from allies so Lux Q Light Binding can’t hit you together.
Lux.phase: Early on, Syndra has high mana and ability-use costs, so focus on farming. Look for a lane advantage as Syndra Q Dark Sphere gains levels. The mid-to-late game, as Syndra gains Splinters and ability power, is her peak, but mispositioning is dangerous, so keep watching for Lux Q Light Binding.
Lux.teamfight: Stay at the back and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for enemies who engage. Don’t approach grouped together with allies where Lux E Lucent Singularity can catch all of you.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, you’re likely to be hit by her follow-up abilities too, so dodge Q and don’t stand in a line with allies. Leave the area where Lux E Lucent Singularity is placed, and sidestep when you see Lux R Final Spark’s aim line. Immediately after being hit by a Lux ability, create distance so she can’t trigger Lux P Illumination with a basic attack.

Malzahar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Malzahar’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Consider Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to deal with the suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Malzahar.combo: First remove Malzahar P Void Shift with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. To set up a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond Malzahar and push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak so the sphere hits him as it travels. To finish him, place more spheres, slow him with Syndra W Force of Will, then push the remaining spheres with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun him before using Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Malzahar.escape: Dodge the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void, and go in when Malzahar W Void Swarm’s summons are gone. Malzahar has no ability to create distance on his own, so remove Malzahar P Void Shift, close the distance, and look for a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. If Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available, don’t follow him alone into an area without vision.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, remove it first with Syndra Q Dark Sphere so your crowd control and burst damage can affect him. Slow him by throwing a sphere or minion with Syndra W Force of Will, then follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. Close the distance when Malzahar W Void Swarm’s summons are gone or haven’t appeared yet, and look for a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Malzahar.laning: Stay away from minions afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions, and don’t fully push the wave and give the enemy jungler a gank angle. When Malzahar pushes out in lane, call your jungler to remove Malzahar P Void Shift and create a chance to kill him together.
Malzahar.phase: Syndra gets stronger in the mid-to-late game with Splinters and ability power, but Malzahar also grows stronger as he gains stacks, so pressure him from the early game and limit his chances to scale.
Malzahar.teamfight: Stay at the back, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere in advance, and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra W Force of Will. If Malzahar W Void Swarm’s summons are already out, clear them with the area damage from Syndra E Scatter the Weak, and use your judgment about when to hold E to knock away enemies who engage. Prepare spheres before using Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill.
Malzahar.watch: When a minion afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect transfers to the nearest enemy, so don’t wait to last-hit beside that minion. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside the line between its two portals to avoid the silence. If you’re caught by Malzahar R Nether Grasp, it suppresses you and deals damage based on your max health, so don’t walk alone through areas without vision while his R is available.

Mel.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Mel’s main damage is magic, and Syndra has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Mel.combo: Draw out Mel W Rebuttal first. Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere behind Mel, then push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun her. You won’t stun her if the sphere is between you and Mel or if you use E without a sphere. To finish her, place as many Syndra Q Dark Spheres as possible, then use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Mel.escape: Sidestep Mel E Solar Snare so its root misses, and go in once Mel W Rebuttal is also down. Mel has no mobility ability, so close the distance and stun her with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak to create a chance to catch her.
Mel.fight: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Mel will step to last-hit and poke her. After drawing out Mel W Rebuttal, throw a sphere or minion with Syndra W Force of Will to slow her, then immediately follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak until you can approach Mel and try to stun her.
Mel.laning: Once Syndra Q Dark Sphere has gained levels, pressure Mel at her last-hit positions and limit the time she has to build Mel R Golden Eclipse. Don’t fully push the wave and give the enemy jungler a gank angle.
Mel.phase: However, Mel R Golden Eclipse’s growth is permanent, putting you at a disadvantage as time passes, so limit her chances to build it from the early game.
Mel.teamfight: Syndra should stay at the back and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Place spheres before a fight to set up a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak and prepare damage for Syndra R Unleashed Power. Save E to knock away enemies who engage. Use R on a target you can confidently kill.
Mel.watch: Mel E Solar Snare roots you if it hits at the center, so dodge to the side. If you throw a Syndra projectile while Mel W Rebuttal is active, it can be reflected, so first use a basic attack to draw out W before using abilities. If Mel has hit you multiple times, watch out for the execute from Mel P Searing Brilliance even if you still have health. After leaving the fight, wait somewhere safe until the stacks disappear.

Orianna.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to build magic resistance. Choose Mercury's Treads.
Orianna.combo: Throw a sphere or minion with Syndra W Force of Will to slow Orianna, then hit her with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. To set up a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond her and push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Before finishing, place as many spheres on the field as possible, then use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Orianna.escape: Orianna has no skill to create distance herself, so look for a chance to close in after Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down. Avoid the spot where her ball is when approaching, and if you reach her, look for a stun with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Orianna.fight: The moment after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her is an opportunity to trade. Orianna E Command: Protect's persistent defensive stats are absent then, so slow her with Syndra W Force of Will and follow with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. If Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down, close the distance and look for a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Orianna.laning: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Orianna steps up to last-hit for a free poke, and don't take auto-attack trades. Don't fully push the wave, and save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to protect yourself.
Orianna.phase: Syndra gets strong in the mid to late game as her fragments and ability power stack, but her defensive stats are low, so position carefully.
Orianna.teamfight: Stay at the back and avoid where Orianna's ball is while disrupting the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Place spheres before the formation closes in to set up a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak and damage with Syndra R Unleashed Power. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to push back approaching enemies, and use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill.
Orianna.watch: Position yourself based on where Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball. Leave the area around the ball, where Orianna W Command: Dissonance can slow you and Orianna R Command: Shockwave can forcibly move you. Early on, also avoid extended auto-attack trades empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup.

Qiyana.build: Qiyana's main damage is physical and Syndra has relatively low armor, so hold on early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Get Zhonya's Hourglass early so you can survive the moment after Qiyana engages.
Qiyana.combo: To poke, throw a sphere or minion with Syndra W Force of Will to slow Qiyana, then hit her with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. To counter Qiyana's engage, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere at your feet or where she will land, then push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun her. Before finishing, place as many spheres as possible, then use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Qiyana.escape: When only Qiyana W Terrashape is down, she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity, so don't go in hastily. In particular, while Qiyana E Audacity is down, counterattack when she uses her combo and remains in front of you by stunning her with Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Qiyana.fight: Keep your distance while Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are available, and save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for defense. When Qiyana uses her skills to engage, push a pre-placed Syndra Q Dark Sphere with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun her and create distance. Counterattack after Qiyana uses her combo and remains in front of you.
Qiyana.laning: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Qiyana steps up to last-hit and poke her, but don't fully push the wave. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak in case Qiyana engages.
Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so build armor and don't give her an advantage then. Qiyana is relatively weaker in the late game while Syndra gets strong as her fragments and ability power stack, but a poor position is dangerous, so maintain your distance and positioning.
Qiyana.teamfight: Syndra should stay at the back and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Place spheres before a fight, save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to push back an engaging Qiyana, and use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill. Move grouped with allies, but stand away from terrain so Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent doesn't catch you all together.
Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal can root with the river element and stealth with the brush element. If she approaches with the river element, move out of range; if she disappears with the brush element, move into an ally's vision. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes on contact with a wall and stuns, so don't stand with your back to a wall and avoid the river and narrow passages.

Ryze.build: Ryze's main damage is magic and Syndra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Hold on early with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads.
Ryze.combo: Throw a sphere or minion with Syndra W Force of Will to slow Ryze, then follow with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. To look for a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond Ryze and push the sphere with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to hit him. Before finishing, place as many spheres on the field as possible, then use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Ryze.escape: After dodging Ryze E Spell Flux, you can look for an opening without worrying about being rooted by Ryze W Rune Prison.
Ryze.fight: Early Ryze lacks mana and damage, so pressure him before he gets his items. Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Ryze steps up to last-hit for a free poke. If you dodge Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison only slows you, making it a good time to trade.
Ryze.phase: Syndra gets strong in the mid to late game as her fragments and ability power stack, but a poor position can get her killed easily, so keep your distance.
Ryze.teamfight: Syndra should stay at the back and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Set up a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak using spheres placed in advance, and push Ryze back if he gets close to deal sustained damage. Use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill.
Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, keep your distance from allies until the mark disappears. While marked, Ryze W Rune Prison roots you and Ryze Q Overload deals increased damage, so prioritize avoiding Ryze E Spell Flux. If you see Ryze R Realm Warp, you can interrupt him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak before it activates.

Sylas.build: Sylas's main damage is magic and Syndra has relatively low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. If Sylas survives your combo through healing from Sylas W Kingslayer, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Sylas.combo: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Sylas will approach or at Syndra's feet, then push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun him and create distance. To poke, throw a sphere or minion with Syndra W Force of Will to slow him, then hit him with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. To finish, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere and throw it with Syndra W Force of Will, then push the remaining spheres with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun him and use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Sylas.escape: The opening for Syndra to go in is while Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down, before it comes back. Stun him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to limit his chance to escape, but account for the fact that Sylas can dash if Sylas W Kingslayer is available.
Sylas.fight: Look for an opening while Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is down and stun him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak before it comes back. Sylas W Kingslayer and Sylas E Abscond / Abduct are both mobility tools, so don't force an engage when only one is down. Sylas W Kingslayer heals more the more health he has lost, so don't delay the finish for long after damaging him.
Sylas.laning: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Sylas steps up to last-hit and poke him, and save Syndra E Scatter the Weak in case he engages.
Sylas.phase: Syndra gets strong in the mid to late game with fragments and ability power, but she is fragile, so position carefully.
Sylas.teamfight: Syndra should stay at the back and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Place spheres before a fight to set up a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak and damage with Syndra R Unleashed Power. If Sylas engages with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, push him back with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun him, and use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill.
Sylas.watch: With Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, the second chain is more dangerous than the first dash. If the chain hits you, Sylas pulls himself toward you and knocks you up, so save your means of dodging for the second chain. Sylas Q Chain Lash explodes late at the crossing point, so move away even if the first hit only clips you.

Talon.build: Buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps early. Talon's damage is physical, so build armor first, then rush Zhonya's Hourglass to survive the moment after an assassin engages. If Syndra's magic damage isn't getting through to Talon, add penetration. If healing from Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy lets him survive your combo, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Talon.combo: When Talon engages, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere at his landing spot or under your own feet, then push him away with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to aim for a stun and create distance. To attack, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere behind Talon, then push the sphere with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun him. Before finishing with Syndra R Unleashed Power, place as many spheres as possible to increase its damage.
Talon.escape: The moment after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is your chance to close the distance and counterattack. If you avoid the slow from Talon W Rake and confirm that Talon R Shadow Assault has already been used, hold him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak and fight. Talon can cross terrain with Talon E Assassin's Path, so watch his escape route when chasing.
Talon.fight: When Talon closes in with Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere at his landing spot and push him away with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to create distance. Usually, hold Syndra E Scatter the Weak to answer his engage. Look for trades by slowing him with Syndra W Force of Will, then hitting him with Syndra Q Dark Sphere.
Talon.laning: Use Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Talon steps up to last-hit, but don't mindlessly push the wave all the way and give the enemy jungler a gank opportunity. When Talon roams, share his position and secure vision along jungle paths. Push the lane when it's safe to make him return to farm.
Talon.phase: Syndra grows stronger in the mid and late game as her shards and ability power stack, while Talon's late-game influence falls off. Hold your position and play for a longer game.
Talon.teamfight: From the backline, disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will, and place spheres before a fight. If Talon reaches your backline, push him away with Syndra E Scatter the Weak and chain crowd control with your allies. Use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill, with spheres ready.
Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake's returning blades hit too, the follow-up with Talon P Blade's End becomes stronger, so even if the first hit lands, move out of the blades' return path. Watch for Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy's dash and Talon E Assassin's Path's terrain-crossing engage, and don't overcommit to a chase while Talon R Shadow Assault is available.

TwistedFate.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game. Syndra has relatively low magic resistance, and most of Twisted Fate's damage is magic, so build magic resistance and choose Mercury's Treads.
TwistedFate.combo: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere behind Twisted Fate, then push the sphere with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun him. If you can slow him first, throw a sphere or minion with Syndra W Force of Will to hit him, then follow with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. Before finishing, place as many spheres as possible, then use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
TwistedFate.escape: You can also go in while avoiding a stun right after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card uses up the gold card. Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere behind him and push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to look for a stun.
TwistedFate.fight: When Twisted Fate is holding the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, fight from outside auto-attack range. If he is holding a blue or red card, or just used the gold card, slow him with Syndra W Force of Will, then hit him with Syndra Q Dark Sphere to look for a trade. While Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, seize the chance to fight by stunning him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
TwistedFate.laning: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Twisted Fate steps up to last-hit for a free poke.
TwistedFate.phase: Syndra gets strong in the mid to late game with Splinters of Wrath and ability power, but she is fragile, so position at the back.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Syndra should stay at the back and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Use Syndra E Scatter the Weak to push back an engaging enemy, and if you see Twisted Fate R Destiny teleporting within range, interrupt his movement with crowd control.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has locked in the gold card, one auto-attack will stun you, so stay outside auto-attack range. Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards deals area damage, so stand behind minions to reduce poke damage.

Veigar.build: Build magic resistance first with a Null-Magic Mantle early. Choose Mercury's Treads to deal with Veigar E Event Horizon.
Veigar.combo: Throw a sphere or minion with Syndra W Force of Will to slow Veigar, then hit him with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. To look for a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond him and push the sphere with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to hit him. Before finishing, place as many spheres on the field as possible to increase the damage of Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Veigar.escape: After Veigar E Event Horizon is down is your chance to close the distance. Veigar has no mobility skill, so if you engage then and stun him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak, it will be difficult for him to escape.
Veigar.fight: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Veigar steps up to last-hit and poke him. When Veigar E Event Horizon is down, close the distance and continue attacking after stunning him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Veigar.phase: Early on, Veigar has few growth stacks and no mobility skill, so you have a chance to pressure him. In the mid to late game, Syndra also gets strong, but Veigar's stacks keep accumulating, so the later the fight, the more you should check Veigar's position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon has been used.
Veigar.teamfight: Stay at the back and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will, placing spheres before the formations meet. Use Syndra E Scatter the Weak to push back an engaging enemy, and use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill. Before an objective fight, check Veigar's position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon has been used.
Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge, so if you're trapped inside, move around and attack from within instead of running toward the edge. Veigar W Dark Matter shows where and when it will land, so watch the ground indicator and dodge to the side. Veigar R Primordial Burst gets stronger the lower your health is, so move out of range if your health falls below half.

Vex.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vex deals mostly magic damage, and Syndra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Vex.combo: When Vex approaches, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where she'll arrive and push her with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun her and create distance. To aim for a stun first, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond Vex, then push the sphere with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Before finishing, place enough spheres on the field, then use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Vex.escape: If both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear and the shield from Vex W Personal Space are down, look for a stun with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Vex.fight: Look for an opening when both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear and the shield from Vex W Personal Space are down. Slow her first with Syndra W Force of Will, then follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere.
Vex.phase: The mid and late game, when Syndra has stacked shards and ability power, is a strong period for her, but poor positioning is dangerous, so fight from the backline.
Vex.teamfight: Let allies marked by Vex R Shadow Surge, especially low-health allies, get away first to prevent Vex from getting consecutive kills.
Vex.watch: When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear is ready, don't fight her at close range; look for an opening right after she uses it on the wave or to poke. Vex E Looming Darkness gets wider the farther it travels, so dodge a short distance to the side while you're in range. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you, move toward your allies and prepare Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak where Vex will dash in.

Viktor.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Viktor's main damage is magic, and Syndra has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Viktor.combo: To aim for a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond Viktor and push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to hit him. You can also poke by slowing him with Syndra W Force of Will, then following up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. Before finishing, place spheres in advance and use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Viktor.escape: Engage after Viktor W Gravity Field is down or after you leave its area. Viktor has no dash, so once you close the distance, stunning him with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak can create a chance to kill him.
Viktor.fight: Poke Viktor with Syndra Q Dark Sphere when he steps up to last-hit. If you slow him with Syndra W Force of Will, immediately follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. If you get a chance to close the distance outside Viktor W Gravity Field, catch him with the stun from Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Viktor.phase: Pressure Viktor early, before Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks up. Syndra also becomes strong in the mid and late game as her shards and ability power stack, but Viktor's scaling accumulates, so this matchup gets harder over time.
Viktor.teamfight: Syndra should stay back, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere in advance, and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra W Force of Will. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to push away opponents who engage, and use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill. Don't continue fighting inside Viktor W Gravity Field.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don't stand in line with the wave; sidestep it. If Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, the longer you stay inside, the greater the risk of being stunned, so leave immediately. Also avoid the area damage from Viktor R Arcane Storm.

Vladimir.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Vladimir's magic damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If Vladimir's healing lets him survive Syndra's combo, apply Grievous Wounds with Morellonomicon.
Vladimir.combo: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere behind Vladimir and push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun him. When looking for a kill, prepare spheres in advance, slow him with Syndra W Force of Will, then follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Syndra R Unleashed Power also uses the spheres on the field, so place enough before using it to finish him.
Vladimir.escape: The moment after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends is your chance to engage. Vladimir has no skill that lets him create distance on his own, so close in then and catch him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Vladimir.fight: Bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first, then look for a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak as it ends. Start trades by slowing him with Syndra W Force of Will, then hitting him with Syndra Q Dark Sphere.
Vladimir.laning: Poke Vladimir with Syndra Q Dark Sphere where he steps up to last-hit, and don't fully push the wave.
Vladimir.phase: Syndra gains power from her shards and ability power in the mid and late game, but Vladimir also becomes harder to face as he scales, so position carefully.
Vladimir.teamfight: From the very back, disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will, and save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to push away opponents who engage. Spread out so several allies aren't hit together by Vladimir R Hemoplague. If you're infected, back off until the effect ends. Use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill after preparing spheres.
Vladimir.watch: Vladimir W Sanguine Pool breaks target locks and destroys incoming projectiles, so check whether it's down before using Syndra E Scatter the Weak. When Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or move out of range. If you're infected by Vladimir R Hemoplague, the damage you take increases, so back off until the effect ends.

Xerath.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Xerath's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build magic resistance.
Xerath.combo: To stun Xerath, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere behind him and push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Syndra E Scatter the Weak alone won't stun him, so check the sphere's position first. Before finishing, place as many spheres as possible, then use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Xerath.escape: The moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your chance to close the distance. Xerath has no mobility, so approach then and look for a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. You can also dodge or approach Xerath while he is unable to move during Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.
Xerath.fight: Close the distance while sidestepping Xerath Q Arcanopulse as he charges it. Right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, slow him with Syndra W Force of Will and follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere.
Xerath.laning: Avoid Xerath's heavy damage while poking with Syndra Q Dark Sphere where he steps up to last-hit. After Xerath has spent a lot of mana, push the lane and call your jungler.
Xerath.phase: Early on, Syndra has high mana and ability demands, so focus on farming. Syndra gets stronger in the mid and late game with Syndra P Transcendent, but her armor is low, so position carefully.
Xerath.teamfight: From the very back, disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Place spheres before a fight to set up a stun angle with Syndra E Scatter the Weak, and use it to push away enemies who engage. Use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so don't try to dodge it by standing behind them. When you see him charging, change direction and sidestep. Be careful not to get stunned by Xerath E Shocking Orb and hit by follow-up attacks. Start dodging as soon as you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane.

Yasuo.build: Buy Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Yasuo's main damage is physical, so build armor first.
Yasuo.combo: When Yasuo engages, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere under your own feet or where Yasuo will arrive, then push him with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to aim for both a stun and distance. To poke first, throw a minion or sphere with Syndra W Force of Will to slow him, then hit him with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. When looking for a kill, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere behind Yasuo and push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to stun him, then finish with Syndra R Unleashed Power once enough spheres are placed.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after Yasuo throws the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest is your chance to engage. Yasuo can use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade to move again, so land the stun from Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak before Yasuo R Last Breath is available, so he can't escape.
Yasuo.fight: Strip Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield with light poke before starting a trade. Right after Yasuo throws the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, the knock-up threat briefly decreases, so pressure him with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. If Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks the angle for your key ability, change your angle or wait for the wall to disappear.
Yasuo.laning: Farm safely from long range, and place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Yasuo steps up to last-hit to poke him without taking damage in return. Keep the wave thin on your side to reduce Yasuo E Sweeping Blade's minion stepping stones, and don't fully push the lane so that the enemy jungler has a gank angle. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for when Yasuo engages.
Yasuo.phase: Syndra grows stronger in the mid and late game as her shards and ability power stack, but she has difficulty surviving being caught, so keep your distance.
Yasuo.teamfight: Syndra should stay at the very back and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Place spheres before the formation closes to set up a stun angle with Syndra E Scatter the Weak, and use E to push Yasuo away when he engages. Use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill after building up spheres.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade lets him use minions as stepping stones to reach Syndra, and Syndra has no mobility, so letting him engage is dangerous.
