After Yasuo lands Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, watch for the knock-up from his next Q, and sidestep when he approaches. A knock-up can lead into Yasuo R Last Breath, so watch for the tornado's sound and visual effect and dodge early.

Zed.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Zed's main damage is physical, so build armor first, then rush Zhonya's Hourglass to survive the moment after he engages.
Zed.combo: To aim for a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond Zed and push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere in advance where Zed will engage and push him away in the same way. When you can kill him, prepare as many spheres as possible, then finish with Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Zed.escape: The opening to attack is after Zed W Living Shadow disappears or after he has already switched positions. If Zed R Death Mark isn't available again yet, engage and look for a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Zed.fight: Immediately after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow, keep your distance and watch for the shadow's movement and slow. Once the shadow disappears or Zed has already switched positions, slow him with Syndra W Force of Will and follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. If Zed gets close, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere at his landing spot and push him away with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to create distance.
Zed.phase: Mid game is a strong period for Zed, so avoid positions where you can be caught alone. Zed gets weaker late while Syndra grows stronger as her shards and ability power stack, so fight grouped with your allies.
Zed.teamfight: From the very back, disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra W Force of Will. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak for when Zed engages, and place spheres before a fight to set up a stun angle. Use Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can confidently kill.
Zed.watch: Watch the position of Zed W Living Shadow. Move outside the range of the shadow's Zed E Shadow Slash to avoid the slow. If Zed engages with Zed R Death Mark, interrupt his combo with Syndra E Scatter the Weak before the mark detonates.

Zoe.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Zoe’s main magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Magic resist does not apply to the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, so keep focusing on dodging the bubble even after building resist.
Zoe.combo: To look for a stun, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond Zoe and push the sphere with Syndra E Scatter the Weak. For a short trade, throw a sphere or minion with Syndra W Force of Will to slow her, then follow up with Syndra Q Dark Sphere. To finish her off, set up a sphere in advance, land a stun with Syndra E Scatter the Weak, then use Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Zoe.escape: The moment Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble goes down is your chance to engage. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, counterattack by aiming at the spot she will return to.
Zoe.fight: Place Syndra Q Dark Sphere where Zoe will step up to last-hit to look for a trade without taking damage in return. While Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble or Zoe R Portal Jump is down, place Syndra Q Dark Sphere beyond her and push it with Syndra E Scatter the Weak to try to stun her. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, make sure to aim at the starting point she will return to.
Zoe.laning: As Syndra Q Dark Sphere gains levels, harass Zoe when she steps up to last-hit, but don’t fully push the wave and create an opening for a gank. Use Syndra E Scatter the Weak carefully so it’s available to interrupt Zoe Q Paddle Star!’s retargeting or to counterattack after Zoe R Portal Jump.
Zoe.phase: Early on, Syndra has high mana and cooldown costs, so prioritize farming safely. In the mid and late game, use the abilities empowered by Syndra P Transcendent and her increased ability power, but fight from the back since poor positioning is dangerous.
Zoe.teamfight: Stay at the very back, set up Syndra Q Dark Sphere in advance, and disrupt the enemy formation with Syndra W Force of Will. Save Syndra E Scatter the Weak to push back enemies who engage, but you can also use it to interrupt Zoe Q Paddle Star!’s retargeting as she throws it. Prepare spheres before using Syndra R Unleashed Power on a target you can reliably kill.
Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you fall asleep after a short delay, making Zoe Q Paddle Star! easy to land. Dodge the bubble; if it hits, move behind a wall or an ally before sleep takes effect and get out of the angle of Zoe Q Paddle Star! If you see Zoe starting to throw Zoe Q Paddle Star!, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can interrupt her retargeting.
